title: BookingExpired v1
description: Booking tells that a booking was not completed in time: its hold deadline passed and its seats are free again. Routing key: booking.booking-expired. It carries identifiers only, no personal data; a consumer that needs more (for example to notify the customer) looks it up itself. Consumers ignore unknown fields (ADR-0009, part F).

eventId.description: ID of this message, used by consumers to recognize duplicates

occurredAt.description: When Booking expired the booking (a little after the deadline, as the sweeper runs every few seconds)

correlationId.description: Null today: the sweeper that expires bookings is not a request

aggregateId.description: The booking; the same as data.bookingId

userId.description: The customer who held the seats
